description: This PHP source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule, which models an XHTML 1.1 module with information on elements, tags, and attributes for the HTMLPurifier library. It provides methods for adding elements, configuring content models, and managing element and attribute definitions within the context of HTML sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule
classes.description: Represents an XHTML 1.1 module, encapsulating elements, tags, attributes, content sets, and transformation rules used for HTML sanitization in the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Retrieves an appropriate child definition object based on content model parameters; default implementation returns false.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Sets up a new HTML element with specified content model, attributes, and content set membership.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Creates a non-standalone, placeholder element definition.

methods.name: addElementToContentSet
methods.description: Registers an element to a specified content set.

methods.name: parseContents
methods.description: Transforms a string describing allowed children into a content model type and expression.

methods.name: mergeInAttrIncludes
methods.description: Merges attribute collection includes into an attribute array.

methods.name: makeLookup
methods.description: Creates a lookup table from a list of values for quick membership checking.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Performs lazy initialization of the module based on configuration, intended to be overridden.
